description: Database integrity ops view: suspect_pages corruption signals, CHECKDB coverage vs SLA (never/stale/ok), PAGE_VERIFY risks. Collector scrapes hourly via DBCC DBINFO + msdb.dbo.suspect_pages.

targets.expr: count((mssql_checkdb_never_run{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"} == 1) or (mssql_checkdb_age_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"} < 0)) or vector(0)

count((mssql_checkdb_age_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"} >= 0) and (mssql_checkdb_age_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"} > ${checkdb_sla})) or vector(0)

count((mssql_checkdb_age_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"} >= 0) and (mssql_checkdb_age_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"} <= ${checkdb_sla})) or vector(0)
sum by (instance, event_type_desc) (mssql_suspect_pages{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", event_type_desc=~"${event_type:regex}"})
topk(15, sum by (instance, db) (mssql_suspect_pages{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", event_type_desc=~"${event_type:regex}"}))
topk(15, sum by (instance, db) (mssql_suspect_pages_error_count{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", event_type_desc=~"${event_type:regex}"}))

count((mssql_checkdb_never_run{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"} == 1) or (mssql_checkdb_age_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"} < 0)) or vector(0)

count((mssql_checkdb_age_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"} >= 0) and (mssql_checkdb_age_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"} > ${checkdb_sla})) or vector(0)

count((mssql_checkdb_age_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"} >= 0) and (mssql_checkdb_age_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"} <= ${checkdb_sla})) or vector(0)

title: Collector database_integrity
